summary: First test pass for StreamVisionAR. Backend: 10/12 pytest cases pass; 2 failures expose a SEED DATA INCONSISTENCY (project.open_issues hardcoded to 3/5/1 while only 2 of 3 seeded issues per project are unresolved). API recompute logic is correct. Frontend: all critical mobile flows verified on 390x844 viewport — onboarding -> dashboard -> project detail -> AR HUD -> punch list -> new-issue create -> issue detail resolve -> feed comment all work end-to-end with proper testIDs.

minor.issue: SEED DATA BUG: SEED_PROJECTS hardcodes open_issues=3/5/1 but only RFI-104 (open) and WI-088 (in_review) of the 3 seeded issues are unresolved -> actual unresolved count is 2 per project. First create/patch call correctly recomputes the counter, but the dashboard initially shows wrong OPEN badges (3/5/1) until any issue mutation happens. Fix: set open_issues=2 in SEED_PROJECTS, or recompute counts at end of seed_if_empty().

ui_bugs.issue: Missing testID 'ar-ghost-slider' on the ghost-mode slider control (slider visually renders and shows 85% value, but the testID is absent from DOM). All other AR HUD testIDs present: ar-layer-structural, ar-layer-mep, ar-capture-button, ar-exit-button.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking, future RN compatibility.

action_items: Fix seed data: in /app/backend/server.py, change SEED_PROJECTS open_issues values to match actual unresolved seeded issues (2 each), OR add a normalization pass at end of seed_if_empty() that recomputes open_issues per project from issues collection.
Add testID='ar-ghost-slider' to the ghost-mode slider element in /app/frontend/app/ar/[id].tsx (the orange horizontal bar showing 85%).
Optional: replace deprecated pointerEvents prop usages with style.pointerEvents to remove console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /api/issues/{id} correctly recomputes project.open_issues after status change — good.
All Mongo reads use projection {'_id': 0} — ObjectId leakage avoided.
POST /api/issues auto-generates ref as PL-00x via count_documents — naming collisions possible if any seeded ref already used PL- prefix, but currently seeds use RFI/WI/NR prefixes so safe.
Backend uses uuid string ids throughout — consistent with spec.
Frontend correctly reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API calls (verified via working integration end-to-end).

success_rate.backend: 83% (10/12, the 2 failures are seed-data bugs not API bugs)

seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed issues and activity comments via API during testing; safe to leave (not destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_streamvisionar.py — run with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend bottom tabs are labeled SITES / PUNCH / FEED / FIELD (not ISSUES). Tab testIDs are not set on the bottom navigator; use page.get_by_text('PUNCH', exact=True) to navigate. AR view on web shows fallback image with full HUD overlay (acceptable per spec). MongoDB seed runs once on startup; if you change seed values, drop the projects collection or use a fresh DB_NAME to re-seed.
rca_of_issue: Seed inconsistency RCA: server.py:113-147 SEED_PROJECTS dict has open_issues values (3,5,1) chosen for display variety, but the SEED_ISSUES loop (lines 175-177) only inserts 3 issues per project of which only 2 are non-resolved (RFI-104 open, WI-088 in_review, NR-051 resolved). The list_projects endpoint returns the stale stored value until create_issue or update_issue triggers a recompute via count_documents on lines 232 / 251. Mitigation: append an open-count recompute loop inside seed_if_empty after issue inserts, or set SEED_PROJECTS open_issues to 2.
